description: Creates a Sitecore item from a template over the Authoring and Management API and returns the created item. The parent must be given as a GUID (the API takes no parent path here) — use authoring-get-item to resolve a path to its ID first.

database.description: The database to create in. Defaults to master.

fields.description: Field values to set on the new item.

language.description: The language to create the first version in, e.g. 'en'.

name.description: The new item's name. Sitecore rejects names containing / \ : ? " < > | [ ].

parent.description: The GUID of the parent item. A path is not accepted — resolve it with authoring-get-item.

templateId.description: The GUID of the template to create from, e.g. '{76036F5E-CBCE-46D1-AF0A-4143F9B557AA}'.

name: authoring-create-item
